mentions.name: SantaWho
mentions.description: A holiday party game played in person with the whole family on a single phone: a parent interviews everyone for jobs at the North Pole and surfaces inner insights about what each person might enjoy from Santa. It is designed for any age, private, and ad-free.
mentions.audience: Families playing together, suitable for any age
mentions.source_excerpt: https://santawho.com A funny holiday game you play in person with the whole family on just one phone (the parent interviews everyone for jobs on the North Pole and surfaces inner insights about what everyone might enjoy from Santa). It’s for any age, private, ads free, just pure holiday spirit.
